Campbell County property tax guide FAQ

Who handles assessment appeals in Campbell County?

Objections go to the county assessor, then the county board of equalization.

Campbell County by the numbers

Campbell County has about 47,018 residents and 19,952 housing units in the Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey, number 3 by population among the 5 Wyoming counties we cover. The median owner-occupied home is worth $266,400, 2% above the median of the Wyoming counties covered. Median household income is $95,253, against $76,464 for the middle Wyoming county. Owners live in 78% of occupied homes and renters in 22%. The median home was built in 1989, about 34 years ago.

Sweetwater County, Wyoming property tax involves the county assessment office and the county treasurer.

Who to contact in Sweetwater County

  • Sweetwater County Treasurer
  • Sweetwater County Assessor handles assessment and appeals.

What we confirmed on official pages

  • Taxes billed Sept 1; notices mailed last working day of August. Pay in two installments (first postmarked/paid by November 10, second by May 10) or in full by December 31; weekend/holiday moves to next working day
  • Interest of 18% per annum on payments received after delinquent dates
  • Taxes unpaid May 11 certified delinquent; demand notice mailed about a week later; unpaid is published three times and lien sold at tax sale; real property taxes are a lien
